svg.title: iOS · Shape-mation · Find shapes · done · locked register · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/FindShapesView.swift (summaryCard + the By project card) over ShapeFinder.Summary after a run in which the only candidate's register was LOCKED — written by a newer LetsLapse (WP0b, 2026-09-19: "read past what you don't understand, never write over it"). Code first; mirrored 2026-09-20 from the Debug build on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator over the wp0b lock root seeded as a second library (Photo 19. 9. at 20:00 with the version-2 shapes.json fixture; -storage.activeLibrary <id>, LL_SHAPEMATION=find LL_SHAPES_SCOPE=all LL_SHAPES_RUN=1), the copy checked against the Mac Debug build's AX dump of the same run. The same pushed screen as shapemation.find.done.portrait.svg — back "Shape-mation", large title "Find shapes" — with the summary card (llCard 18, 16-pt padding) now reading, top to bottom: "Nothing analysed" (17 semibold — "N projects analysed" when any was), the detector line "Standard · all/medium/all" (13 secondary: detector · sensitivity/size/family — the simulator's fresh defaults; the Mac's stored options read "Use all · all/high/all"), "0 with at least one shape" (14), the four family chips in family order (13 medium capsules, every one at secondary 12 % with glyph and count in tertiary since every count is 0), then — NEW with WP0b — the tally line "1 register left as it was: written by a newer LetsLapse, or unreadable." (13 secondary, "N registers left as they were: …" in the plural; absent when none was), and the two run buttons "Run again" (borderedProminent, accent, 15 semibold) · "Change options" (plain, accent). Under it the BY PROJECT card: header "By project" (15 semibold secondary) with "0 ms median" trailing (12 monospaced secondary), then one row per candidate — the title (15), the verdict "failed" (13, system orange, LL.levelOff) and "0 ms" (12 monospaced secondary) trailing, and the reason under the title in 12 system orange: "Shapes written by a newer LetsLapse" (or "unreadable"). The register itself is untouched by the run — verified against the fixture after the capture. Same canvas conventions as the other Find shapes mirrors: canvas y = the 402×874-pt capture's y (the sheet's top at 72, the card at 196), trailing edges 9 pt further left.
